briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 escalate AGI capability race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Prompt injection and multi-agent security emerge as critical bottlenecks. Global AI investment surges past $11B this quarter.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4; DeepSeek launches R2. xAI Grok-3 nears public beta with real-time web integration.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft expands Stargate supercluster. TSMC allocates 40% capacity to AI chips through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve autonomous goal coordination before 2027 safety standards?
